events.summary: Lim-Dûl calls on Leshrac for the power he is due.
events.quote: Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due.

events.summary: Saffi Eriksdotter warns Hans to run from the lhurgoyf, her last words.
events.quote: Ach! Hans, run! It's the lhurgoyf!

events.summary: Lovisa Coldeyes vows peace will come only when Varchild is beheaded.
events.quote: Peace will come only when we have taken Varchild's head.

events.summary: Halvor Arenson's healers deal with the aftermath of the Yavimaya Valley disaster.
events.quote: I was shocked when I first saw the aftermath of the Yavimaya Valley disaster.
